portfolio_scope.meaning: Observe progress from every repository owned by jussray; per-repository entries are privacy/output overlays, not an allowlist.

note: Per-repository entries are optional privacy/output overlays. Repository scope is dynamic all_owned and must not be narrowed by this file. Review containsMinorOrSensitiveData, publicProofUrls, neverClaim, and neverExpose before a public draft is generated. See docs/founder-signal-engine/social-campaign-policy-v1.md.

jussray/Sekret-Bip._gate: config/repository-visibility-policy.json currently targets this repository for privatization (priority: critical, action: privatize_then_create_clean_showcase_export). containsMinorOrSensitiveData is allowed only through sanitized_product_only when reviewed publicProofUrls and a non-empty neverExpose output denylist exist; otherwise classifyRepositoryForContent() blocks draft generation — see socialCampaignPolicy.ts.
